subject: general
question: 2 times the present age of X is 7 years less than 6 times the present age of Y. At present, P is 2 times as old as X, and Y is 8 years younger than Q. If P is 50 years older than Q, then the present age (in years) of Y is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the age of **Y** be **y**.

From **Q = y + 8** and **P = Q + 50** → **P = y + 58**.

Also, **P = 2X** → **X = (y + 58)/2**.

Equation: **2X = 6Y − 7** ⇒ **y + 58 = 6y − 7**.

Solving: **5y = 65** ⇒ **y = 13**.

**∴ The correct answer is 13 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2408c433b79e7e65ce2d79b09fa7bae1de82ac2d07425946f48bd612a08f28b9.png] 

**Given:**

1. 2X = 6Y − 7

2. P = 2X

3. Y = Q − 8 ⇒ Q = Y + 8

4. P = Q + 50

**Calculations:**

⇒ Substitute (2) into (1): P = 6Y − 7

⇒ Substitute (4) into the above: Q + 50 = 6Y − 7

⇒ Substitute (3) into the above: (Y + 8) + 50 = 6Y − 7

⇒ Y + 58 = 6Y − 7

⇒ 6Y − Y = 58 + 7

⇒ 5Y = 65

⇒ Y = 65 ÷ 5 = 13

**∴ The correct answer is 13 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Difference Constant

The difference between the ages of two people remains **constant** regardless of the number of years passed or future time.

Ratio Method for Ages

If the ratio of ages is given for two different time periods, equate the **parts** by making the difference between ratios equal.

Linear Equations in Ages

Always define variables for **present ages** to avoid confusion when moving back to the past or forward to the future.</p
